headline: Missile Threat Looms Over Kyiv as Israel Intensifies Regional Strikes
subheadline: A reactive Shakhid missile was observed 40 km from Kyiv with impact expected in 11 minutes, while Israel conducted over 500 strikes across Lebanon and Gaza in the past month.
lede: A reactive Shakhid missile was detected 40 kilometers from Kyiv, with impact expected in 11 minutes, as Russia launched mass attacks on energy infrastructure across multiple Ukrainian regions. Simultaneously, the Israeli Air Force conducted over 500 strikes in the past month across Lebanon and Gaza, targeting 370 Hezbollah sites and 140 Hamas positions. The IDF also eliminated key operatives in Gaza and Khan Younis for ceasefire violations, while a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.

sections.title: Missile Threat Looms Over Kyiv
sections.body: A reactive Shakhid missile was observed 40 km from Kyiv, with impact expected in 11 minutes according to local monitoring. Russia conducted mass attacks on energy infrastructure causing emergency power outages in Kyiv, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, and Zhytomyr oblasts. Multiple unmanned aerial vehicles are moving toward Kyiv from Chernihiv, Dnipro, and Cherkasy directions. Civilian targets including schools in Solomiansky district suffered drone strikes during recent operations.

sections.title: Israel Strikes Hezbollah and Hamas Targets
sections.body: The Israeli Air Force conducted over 500 strikes in the past month across Lebanon and Gaza, including 370 Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon and 140 Hamas targets in Gaza. The IDF eliminated Palestinian Islamic Jihad rocket operative Bilal Mahmoud Suleiman Samiri in Khan Younis for ceasefire violations. Two Hamas commanders were killed in Gaza: Muhammad Abdulaziz Muhammad Nassar, who infiltrated on Oct 7 and posed as a journalist, and Amar Mahmoud Hamed Sharafi, a Hamas platoon commander in Gaza City. A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, and Saudi Arabia reported a Houthi drone and missile attack on its southern territory.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The conflict is expanding across multiple fronts, with Israel maintaining high-tempo strikes in Gaza and Lebanon while facing rocket threats. Iranian-backed Houthi attacks threaten Red Sea shipping and Saudi territory, and the Strait of Hormuz tanker incident signals maritime escalation risk. Coordination between Iranian proxies appears active despite Iranian denials of involvement in Syria-Hezbollah talks.
